evidence: Page problems-15.png prints the heading of section A.9, then the full circular diagram Рис. A.1, then its caption. The diagram shows the ecliptic constellations, the number of days the Sun spends in each (for example Лев 37 д, Дева 45 д, Змееносец 18 д) and the boundary dates (16.09, 10.08, 21.07 and so on). The published paper.documentNotes entry 'A.9. Диаграмма видимого годичного движения Солнца по эклиптике' (page 15) contains only the bold heading and the caption text, with no image. The transcription note confirms the drawing was attached only to the solution of problem 15, as p15-sol-fig3. So the drawing exists on the site, but not in the reference data section. That data is what the statement of problem 15 implicitly depends on: the problem asks which constellation the signal came from on 2 February, so a student needs the diagram, and the solution's text points to 'рис. A.1 приложение A'. A student working from the statement and the reference data cannot see the diagram without opening the official solution. I rate it major rather than minor: a whole printed figure is lost from the reference section, but the information still survives on the site.
